Select target ChEMBL ID, target name, target type, protein accession, and protein sequence. Join target_dictionary to component_sequences on target_components and target_components. Filter for target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' and organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Return target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, protein_accession, protein_sequence. Sort by target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, protein_accession, protein_sequence.
